body.html:
Barkpark Papers · cookbook · query-carrying blocks

Query blocks: papers that watch the system.

Seven copy-paste recipes for the PortableDoc blocks that resolve LIVE task data at render time. A block carries query instead of snapshot/series/cells/value; the reader injects fresh data on every render and re-renders on task events. Author-pinned data still works offline - a block with literal rows and no query is never touched.

TaskResolver · rows_for_query · agg_for_query · live demo: /papers/cloud-console-hardening-dashboard

01 · row queries — boards, lists, roadmaps, detail

The row-query contract

Blocks tasks, task-list, task-board, roadmap accept: parent_id (prefix-agnostic parent match), status (open maps through the COALESCE default; open-with-no-blockers surfaces as ready), label/labels, kind, dataset, limit (default 500, max 1000). task-detail takes the same query and renders the first match.

02 · aggregate queries — stat, chart, heatmap

The aggregate contract

The same three data-viz blocks that take authored values also take a query with a closed vocabulary: filter reuses the row filters; groupBy is a dim from status · label · parent · assignee · priority · phase, or a time bucket; over adds a day/week/month axis on inserted_at/updated_at/closed_at with last N; agg defaults to count (sum/avg/min/max exist but are k-anon suppressed below 5 rows and field-whitelisted). Tenancy is fail-closed - a foreign workspace resolves to an empty tally, never someone else's numbers.

03 · shaping — what the resolver injects

Tally to attrs, mechanically

stat gets value = total (plus a spark array when over is present). chart gets series: one per groupBy label, points along the time buckets (or the single total). heatmap gets cells + rowLabels/colLabels + max from a two-dimensional groupBy. Absent count cells are honest zeros; suppressed measure cells stay nil and render the dim placeholder.

04 · liveness, degrade, editing

The three environments

Reader: BulldocsLive resolves queries with the paper's workspace scope and re-resolves on task. mutation events - no republish, ever. Offline/WASM: no aggregate fetcher is wired, so query blocks keep their dim placeholder while author-pinned blocks render fully. Studio*: the editor never persists resolved rows - a parallel preview channel feeds the canvas so the saved document keeps the query as the source of truth (byte-stability doctrine).
